newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Orchit Nasdaq IPO this week.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Orchit Nasdaq IPO this week.

text.p: Orchit Communications' initial public offering (IPO) on Nasdaq is expected to be priced on Wednesday or Thursday at $14 to $16 a share, Israeli investment sources said.
The price for the 3.3 million share offering has increased from an original estimate of $12 to $14.

An Israeli investment source attributed the higher price to the strong demand for Orchit shares, adding that it was one of the most sought after Israeli IPOs in the United States. Most of the demand has been from U.S. institutional investors.
At $14 to $16, Orchit would raise $45 million to $50 million, valuing the company at $200 million.
Alex Brown, represented in Israel by Tel Aviv-based Giza Group, is acting as lead underwriter. Montgomery and Oppenheimer are co-underwriters.
Orchit was founded in 1990 and its local loop telecommunications technology allows clients to send additional voice and data communications over existing copper wires.
An investment source said demand for Orchit shares was high because of the field in which it operates as well as its innovative technology.
Last year the company had sales of $6.5 million and lost $1.1 million, mainly because of high research and development costs. Results for the first-half of 1996 were not available.
Orchit plans to use about $10 million from the offering for development and $10 million to expand marketing channels.
The Mofet venture capital fund holds 4.3 percent of Orchit.
